mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO reminder (plan_id, user_id, plan_drug_id, drug_name, scheduled_date, scheduled_time, scheduled_at, status) VALUES
(#{r.planId}, #{r.userId}, #{r.planDrugId}, #{r.drugName}, #{r.scheduledDate}, #{r.scheduledTime}, #{r.scheduledAt}, 'PENDING')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE plan_id = VALUES(plan_id)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reminder WHERE plan_drug_id = #{planDrugId} AND scheduled_date = #{date} AND scheduled_time = #{time}

mapper.update: UPDATE reminder r SET r.status = 'TRIGGERED' WHERE r.status = 'PENDING' AND r.scheduled_at <= NOW() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM medication_plan p WHERE p.id = r.plan_id AND p.status = 'ACTIVE')

UPDATE reminder r SET r.status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE r.status IN ('PENDING', 'TRIGGERED') AND r.scheduled_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM medication_plan p WHERE p.id = r.plan_id AND p.status = 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalDoses, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'TAKEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmedDoses, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missedDoses FROM reminder WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scheduled_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalDoses, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'TAKEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmedDoses FROM reminder WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
